invariants.rationale: The returned list of WriteStatus should not be null, as the write operation should always produce a list (possibly empty).
The input list of HoodieRecord for deletePrepped should not be null to execute the operation safely.
The instantTime (commit time) should never be null for a data write operation.
If result contains any element, none should be null—WriteStatus lists should contain only non-null entries.
If preppedRecords contains any element, none should be null—record lists should be well-formed.
